analyzed_vuln.description: `xmlXIncludeIncludeNode` can double-free/use-after-free fallback content because it frees children of the include node with `xmlFreeNode(child)` in a loop even when those children are part of a linked sibling list copied from fallback processing. Freeing one child recursively frees its siblings via `xmlFreeNodeList`, then the loop advances to `next` (already freed), leading to UAF in `xmlFreeNodeList` on the second iteration. The crash appears in `xmlFreeNodeList` but the ownership/free logic bug is in `xmlXIncludeIncludeNode`'s fallback-children removal loop.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered via the xml fuzz harness when XInclude processing is enabled (`xmlXIncludeProcessFlags` in `fuzz/xml.c`) and malformed/nested `<xi:include>` with `<xi:fallback>` causes `xmlXIncludeLoadFallback` to populate `ctxt->incTab[nr]->inc` from `xmlDocCopyNodeList(fallback->children)`, then `xmlXIncludeIncludeNode` enters the non-`XML_PARSE_NOXINCNODE` path with `fallback` set and executes the child-removal loop. Input must produce multiple fallback/include children so `child->next` is non-NULL; then first `xmlFreeNode(child)` frees sibling chain, and loop reuses stale `next`, causing heap-use-after-free.
